items.title: Mama's Egusi 🍲
items.fact: Egusi soup is rich in fibre and protein from the egusi seeds and vegetables.
items.activity: her home kitchen full of cultural details
narration: My mornings are stiff, my dear. At our age, warm meals help.
So I do this: I start by boiling the egusi seeds. Then I prepare the vegetables.
Next, I chop the onions and peppers. I use a sharp knife safely.
After that, I add the chopped vegetables to the pot. I let it simmer gently.
This egusi soup helps me feel warm and comforted. It's gentle on my stomach.
Try making egusi soup tomorrow, my friends, and tell me how it warms your heart. Share your own recipes with me.
items.description:
Learn how to make traditional Nigerian egusi soup with Mama Ngozi. This recipe uses egusi seeds, onions, peppers, and your choice of protein. Try making it tomorrow and share in the comments how it turned out for you. Don't forget to subscribe for more recipes and tips from Mama Ngozi.

Today's grandma wisdom: Egusi soup is rich in fibre and protein from the egusi seeds and vegetables.

items.title: Teta's Morning Stretch 🌞
items.fact: Regular morning stretching improves flexibility and reduces stiffness in older adults.
narration: My mornings are stiff, my dear. I struggle to get out of bed at our age.
So I do this: first, I sit tall on the edge of my bed. I take a deep breath and feel the air fill my lungs.
Next, I lift my right knee towards my chest, then lower it back down gently. I repeat this motion with my left knee.
After that, I stand up and stretch my arms over my head, feeling the stretch in my shoulders and back. I take another deep breath and let my arms fall back down.
This morning routine helps me loosen up my muscles and feel more energized throughout the day. It's a simple habit that makes a big difference at our age.
Try it tomorrow morning, my friends, and tell me in the comments how you feel. Remember to always consult your doctor if you have any concerns about your health.
items.description:
Join Teta Leila as she shares her morning stretching routine to help improve flexibility and reduce stiffness. This simple habit can make a big difference in your daily life. Try it out and share in the comments how it went! Don't forget to consult your doctor if you have any health concerns.
